growth_signal.value: Named in VivaTech's 2026 Top 100 Rising European Startups, which needs 40%+ yearly growth.

entry.idea: Staff now build apps and AI helpers on their own, which leaves IT and security teams blind, so Tines gives everyone one safe place to build.
entry.lesson: When a new tool lets everyone build, there is a business in giving the safety team control without slowing people down.

growth.reason: VivaTech's list requires at least EUR 5M revenue and 40% yearly growth, and Tines made the 2026 list.

market.reason: Every large company needs to govern automation and AI use.

tech.reason: Solid product, but rivals could copy workflow tools in a year or so.

entry.twist: It started as no-code workflow tools for security teams, and now adds visibility and control over AI-made work.
entry.who_pays: Companies pay for it, mainly their IT and security teams.
entry.why_now: AI lets every team build software, and companies need to see and govern what gets built.
